# Dev Mapper

> Africa's SDG and ESG tracking platform — monitor sustainable development goal progress, ESG compliance, climate action, and grassroots impact across the continent in real time.

Dev Mapper helps citizens, NGOs, governments, and corporates report, verify, and analyse sustainability projects aligned to the UN SDGs, AU Agenda 2063, GRI, CDP, CSRD, SBTi, TCFD, IFRS S1/S2, and Nigeria FRC SRG1. Features include a verified change-maker registry, carbon accounting, a carbon marketplace, fundraising campaigns, and the Ndovu Akili AI assistant.
